title: TAN-PAN Consolidated file
text:
# TAN-PAN Consolidated file
This a consolidated file containing details of all Tax Payers related to a TAN of deductor. This file consists of the valid PANs for which the TAN has filed TDS / TCS statement.
  1. Deductor logs in to TRACES.
  2. Go to statement/ payment tab.
  3. Select PAN verification.
  4. Enter the details in consolidate TAN-PAN file and click on go

Go to <https://traces.tdscpc.gov.in/auth/login/loginScreen> to visit website
